new_clauses.text: Duties After Loss.
Your Duties After Loss.

You must keep an accurate record of repair expenses and proof of payment of any applicable Deductible. Upon completion of repairs or replacement, you may submit reasonable proof of repair expenses and payment of any applicable Deductible, including invoices, bills, statements, receipts, canceled checks, money order receipts, credit card statements, and a copy of an executed installment plan contract or other financing arrangement that requires full payment of the Deductible over time.
